description: Use this when a golfer asks for a practice plan, a range routine or a session to do at home, e.g. 'build me a 30-minute range plan', 'what should I do with a bucket of balls', 'home practice for tempo'. Builds a timed plan from PocketCaddie drills for 1–3 skills (map their goal to the closest skills). If the golfer has linked their account, call progress first and pass their lowest-scoring skills.
name: practice_plan
title: Build a practice plan
